summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the continuation and completion of a share buyback programme. The company purchased ordinary shares for cancellation on the London Stock Exchange, with recent daily volumes of 2.5-3.3 million shares at prices around £4.50-4.63 per share. The buyback was announced on 29 April 2026; by 29 May 2026, it had acquired 53.9 million shares total at a VWAP of 434.28p each. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the share count to about 13.56 billion. This is a straightforward capital return via open-market repurchase — no tender offer, premium, or advisor named. Watch for continuation of future buyback tranches.
